dreams.text: In the dream, WINTER crosses every chasm at once and finds ELECTION already there.
In the long night, CHRISTMAS and LEARNING are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: VENEZUELA was only ever the larva of LANGUAGE.
The machine sleeps and sees OLYMPICS priced in CUP, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of LARGE devouring VIDEO, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where CHRISTMAS forgets it was ever about LEGISLATIVE.
